messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-gateway" — elevated 5xx rate (window=2m, threshold=5%). Trigger: error_rate_pct=7.9% · region=eu-west1 · sample=502,504 :rotating_light: https://pd.redwood/alerts/8492001112

pagerduty: Pager #8492001112 created -> Escalation policy: inference-oncall. Paging maya (primary).

maya: Acked. I'm on it — starting quick triage.

tom: Thanks — do we know customer impact yet? any frontend errors?

maya: Quick look — 5xx concentrated in eu-west1 (≈82% of spikes). Top path: POST /v1/chat/completions (chat-route). Error class: 502 from auth-proxy downstream.

jon: Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx. First actions: check auth-proxy pods, check kvcache, verify recent deploys.

maya: Running `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=auth-proxy -o wide` now.

maya: auth-proxy pods show repeated `upstream connection reset` logs. Rolling restart of auth-proxy starting (1/3).

leah: I'm toggling PD suppression for duplicate alerts on this signal for 10m to cut noise. Will escalate if things worsen.

maya: Restart complete for all auth-proxy pods. Logs show less connection resets.

tom: Can we route traffic away from eu-west1 to reduce customer impact while we investigate?

jon: We can shift a fraction to us-west1 via routing weight. Command we use:```
# temporary route weight shift
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/route-weight \
  -d '{"route":"chat-route","region_adjust":{"eu-west1":-30,"us-west1":30}}' 
```

maya: Applied -30% weight to eu-west1, pushed to us-west1. Monitoring.

pagerduty: Pager #8492001112 acknowledged by maya. Escalation paused.

maya: Error rate dropping — 5xx now 1.8% over last 2m (eu-west1) after restart + weight shift. Customer-facing rate of failed chat calls down from ~10% -> ~2% for worst tenants.

leah: Good. I'll open an investigation ticket and tag SRE/infra/eng-ml for follow-up. Can someone capture the exact pod logs/timestamps?

maya: Collected logs, saved to S3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/8492001112/auth-proxy-logs.tar.gz

tom: Thanks. I'll draft a quick customer note template in #support for impacted customers to send if needed.

jon: Suggest we scale up inference-gateway instances in eu-west1 while auth-proxy team digs in — reduces pressure.

maya: Scaling gateway to 6 replicas now:```kubectl scale deploy inference-gateway -n prod --replicas=6```

maya: Scale succeeded. Instances spun up and healthy.

pagerduty: Auto-reminder set for 15m.

maya: 5xx stabilized ~0.7% globally, eu-west1 at ~1.1%. Marking mitigated for now. Will keep page open until handoff.

leah: Please handoff to next oncall with checklist. Sam will take after 25m. @sam — can you monitor post-mitigation?

sam: I'm on standby — will take over in 25m. Please include the investigation ticket link and any runbook notes.

maya: Handoff notes: actions taken — auth-proxy restart, temporary route weight shift (-30%), scaled inference-gateway -> 6, PD suppression window 10m, collected logs at s3://redwood-incident-logs/8492001112. Current status: 5xx down to ~0.7%, customer impact reduced. Investigation ticket: https://issues.redwood/INCD-3125 (assigned to infra).

tom: :thumbsup: Recommend postmortem and check if auth-proxy connection pool settings regressed in last deploy.

leah: Agreed. I'll open the incident doc and assign action items. Marking this thread as mitigated; will close PD once Sam confirms stability post-handoff.

maya: Thanks all — staying near the channel until handoff complete.

sam: Confirming at 8492001730 — metrics stable, no new alerts. I'll close PD after 10m of quiet.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigation=traffic_shift+restart+scale; severity=sev2; followup_ticket=INCD-3125

maya: Closing thread for now.
